fto-dayan-fto.evidence: DaYan FTO is the recognizable product label. Magnetic ball-core, black/primary internals and SAOCube or other setup editions remain one entry.

fto-other-diansheng-galaxy.evidence: Original DianSheng Galaxy/ Galaxy Clusters magnetic FTO. Retained for existing owners as a distinct older generation, not a current recommendation over NEO.

fto-other-diansheng-galaxy-neo.evidence: NEO is an actual named successor rather than a cosmetic SKU. Internal colors, limited editions and retailer modifications are grouped. DS abbreviates DianSheng to keep the alias readable within 12 characters.

fto-qiyi-fto.evidence: QiYi FTO is the recognizable family label. Magnetic and nonmagnetic tiled versions are grouped; the family reference does not imply magnetic hardware.

curation_notes: Four model families across the three requested manufacturers; named DianSheng generations remain separate.
ShengShou/SengSo and LanLan exist, but are excluded from this compact competitive-focused catalog.
Only conventional full-size FTO is covered. 2x2 FTO/skewb diamond, Master FTO and shape modifications are excluded.
No subjective Reddit ranking is stored as a hardware specification.

brand_site_checks.result: Official indexed content confirms NEO; direct fetch failed. English indexed product content confirms original Galaxy Clusters FTO.
Homepage read. Indexed 2x2 octahedron product was excluded because it is not the conventional FTO catalog event. Exact full-size models confirmed by retailer collection.
Direct fetch failed; retailer product page confirms model. No official verification claimed.
